title: Sell Authentically and Build Genuine Relationships
primary_theme: Authentic Investor Communication as Dialogue, Not Slide Performance
founder_lessons: Research the investor and adapt the first meeting to their focus, thesis, and pace.
Treat the first investor call as a sales conversation that can later evolve into a partnership discussion.
Use your strengths for credibility, but keep the conversation at the level the listener needs.
Communicate authentically and empathetically; the objective is to talk to someone, not merely talk through slides.
notable_quotes: the whole objective of whatever meeting is happening is that you're talking to someone. It's a dialogue.
The best entrepreneurs are exceptional at managing pace, cadence at each call and every meeting,
